title: The Three Icons in the Righteous Man — Pneumatic, Psychic, Somatic
description: Three discrete icons exist in the elect: pneumatic (the New Man, where the Mind of Light fashions himself a dwelling), psychic (the residue bound to flesh, the Old Man), somatic (the body containing them all). The daily soul-cycle of descent through eating and ascent through purification, releasing what is not her own at each level. The Virgin of Light blazes a path and draws the soul into the icon of the Indweller, sealing her in all the members of the New Man with Agape as queen — the first and the last.
